sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Earth Release, Fuinjutsu, Stable.

system.description:
You manifest 5 Large, crystalline pillars in spaces found on the edges of your jutsu’s radius. Each pillar releases heavy waves of crystal energy across everything within the jutsu’s radius. Select a point on the space you currently occupy. This point becomes the center of this jutsu’s radius.

All allied creatures that cast jutsu inside the radius of this jutsu, has their effect amplified increasing the damage they deal by +1 damage die.

Additionally, creatures summoned as a result of a Shoton Hijutsu you cast within this jutsu’s affected area gains the Crystal Dynamics ability.

Crystal Dynamics (Recharge 5-6). This creature can cast Crystal Needles, Crystal Wheel or Gods Crossing, at their base rank.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, the Crystal Dynamics ability recharges at the end of your turn, for this jutsu’s duration.
